meta.notes: input is parsed with Color::parse(); the result must be in 'space' with the expected coordinates (null = missing) and alpha. 'compare_in' names the space the example states its result in when it differs from the result space (compared after conversion). Each case has 'abs': half a unit of the coarsest printed digit, or, where a note says so, the distance between the example's intermediate values (computed with an earlier revision of the conversion code) and the current CSS Color 4 conversion. Not transcribed: § 3.3 'teal 0%, olive 0%' (its lightness arithmetic 54.31% × 0.5 + 58.07% × 0.5 = 35.0395% is wrong; the result is 56.19%); examples that use calc(); the § 4.4 lightseagreen HSL example (printed as whole percentages).

cases.note: The example mixes the rounded LCh values of peru and palegoldenrod (3 decimals).
